blurbs.aboutMe:
Hey, I'm Fady. I'm a frontend-leaning developer currently doing my Master's in Applied Computing at the University of Windsor, after a B.Sc. in Computer Science from Memorial University of Newfoundland. Most of my work has been React and React Native, but grad school has been pulling me further into fullstack and systems territory.

Code is a big part of what I do, but it's not the whole story. I like meeting new people, I'll take any excuse to travel, and most of my free time goes to things that have nothing to do with a keyboard: board games, cooking, worldbuilding projects that live entirely in my notes app, and hopefully guitar someday soon.

This site is one of those side projects that got a little out of hand. I could have made a normal portfolio, but I got attached to the idea of building it as a fake operating system instead.
blurbs.whoIdLikeToMeet: People from anywhere, doing anything, honestly. I like hearing how other people ended up where they are. Other developers who take their side projects a little too seriously. Anyone up for a board game that takes way longer to explain than to play.

interests.label: General
interests.value: Board games, especially ones with too many rules. Cooking, mostly by feel rather than recipe. Worldbuilding projects that never see daylight. Traveling whenever I get the chance.

interests.label: Music
interests.value: Classic rock, heavy on Pink Floyd and David Gilmour specifically. Hoping to actually learn guitar one of these days, with Shine On You Crazy Diamond as the goal. Also a big fan of video game and movie soundtracks, especially as background for focused work.

interests.label: Movies
interests.value: Forrest Gump, Finding Nemo, Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, and The Martian. Not exactly a consistent genre, but they're the ones I'll always rewatch.

interests.label: Books
interests.value: An eclectic pile spanning fantasy, sci-fi, literary fiction, theology, and philosophy, tracked a little too meticulously in a Notion database.

interests.label: Heroes
interests.value: The friends and family who got me here. I wouldn't be anywhere close to where I am without them.
